description: nhflow_2d_si_tidal_flat_kepsilon with salinity and temperature (A 600 2): linear initial fields (A 602, A 603), the sea values at the clamped edge with the Thatcher-Harleman return of 1800 s (A 607, A 608), vertical diffusion from k-epsilon (A 605), TVD van Leer (A 609 2) with substeps. The tracer mass changes by the boundary inflow only (to 4e-15 of the mass per step, REEF3D_NHFLOW_tracer.dat), no value leaves the bounds of its neighbours. Long-run statistics (P 160) from 1 h with the tracer maps (mean of the depth mean, bottom and top, max and min).
covers: nhflow_tracer_SI: omega of the transport, TVD faces, column operator, Thatcher-Harleman, substeps, flushed shoreline layers, log and gauges
nhflow_longrun: the tracer sums and maps
